spanish: Solo todo jérem que jermare varón a Jehová desde todo lo que a él, desde adam y bestia y desde campo de su posesión, no será vendido, y no será redimido; todo jérem santidad de santidades él a Jehová.

findings.issue: Common noun חֵרֶם is dumped untranslated as jérem; common nouns stay Spanish.
Hiphil imperfect 3ms verb is dumped as the coined form jermare instead of Spanish.
אָדָם is morphology common noun, not a proper name, and is left as Hebrew adam.
Affirmation particle is narrowed to restrictive Solo.
Unmarked lo only smooths the relative into lo que and adds no new concept.

notes: Niphal passives, קדש קדשים, and Jehová match the tokens.
